messages:
marie_sales: quick sync — AcmeCorp wants a POC gating plan for SSO+SCIM + RBAC mapping. They need a staging window where we can run identity cutover tests. Who owns the gating checklist and can estimate pricing delta for Dedicated vs Hosted for high auth volume? cc @devon_se @sam_security

devon_se: I can own the tech checklist. Quick asks: how many users, expected auth TPS, and do they need assertion encryption? Also need sample IdP metadata to test ACS + NameID mapping.

rachel_customer: Hi team — we have ~50k users, peak login TPS ~40/s during business hours, SCIM delta expected every 5m, and our security team requires Encrypted Assertions (HTTP-POST w/ encrypted assertion). We can share Okta metadata and a SAML cert.

sam_security: Heads-up: security questionnaire will ask about KMS, key rotation, audit logs retention, SOC2 status, and whether SCIM sync goes over private peering. We can support KMS (customer-managed KMS for Private), cloud HSM for Dedicated. Need to confirm log retention SLAs.

jess_pm: Staging window constraints: for a cutover test we need a reserved Dedicated instance for the window (to avoid noisy neighbors), DB migration lock-free approach, and a rollback plan. Proposal: 2-hour window per region, pre-seed KV/cache with sample tokens, and a canary of 200 users first.

devon_se: Plan sketch + config snippet to test mapping: ```
# sample SAML settings
entityID: https://acme.example.com/saml/metadata
assertionConsumerService:
  - url: https://redwood-inference.com/saml/acs
nameIDFormat: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
attributeMapping:
  groups: roles
  email: user.email
```
Please send IdP metadata and sample SCIM user payloads (roles, groups) so I can wire a mapping test.

marie_sales: Pricing question: customer asked for a rough ballpark — if we reserve Dedicated for a 2-hour window + 1-month dev reservation vs purely Hosted burst pricing, what's the delta? They also want per-100k-auths pricing band for Hosted.

ops_oncall: For a short 2-hour Dedicated reservation we usually charge a one-time reservation fee + pro-rated hourly capacity; estimate = monthly min * (2/720) + reservation surcharge. For ballpark numbers: Dedicated monthly commit = $40k/mo for this tier; 2 hours pro-rate ~= $111. Hosted per-auth could be ~ $0.0008/auth for heavy auth paths (auth + SCIM ops) — rough. Put as estimate only.

rachel_customer: That's helpful. Compliance note: our legal will require a data flow diagram showing SCIM delta over TLS, retention windows for audit logs, and proof of KMS controls. Can someone own the security questionnaire answers?

sam_security: I’ll take the questionnaire. Can you drop the security contact and the deadline? Also need to know if the PII in SCIM includes ssn or other regulated fields.

rachel_customer: Security contact is amy.security@acme.example.com. No SSNs in SCIM, only name, email, title, department, role tags. Deadline is EOD next Tuesday.

devon_se: Action items: 1) Acme to drop IdP metadata + SCIM sample payloads (rachel). 2) Devon to provision a short-lived Dedicated environment for the cutover test (needs ops confirmation). 3) Sam to own security questionnaire. 4) Marie to share ballpark pricing and formal quote after POC scope locks.

ops_oncall: I can provision a Dedicated test node but need 48h lead time and a signed PO for capacity reservation. If they want Private (VPC) we'll need networking approvals which add ~5 business days.

marie_sales: Ok scheduling: propose cutover trial Wed 09:00-11:00 PST next week. Rachel — does that work? If yes, I’ll calendar invite and attach prerequisites checklist.

rachel_customer: Wed 09:00 PST works. I’ll get IdP metadata and SCIM payloads in next 24h. Thanks everyone. :pray:

deploy-bot: [info] capacity-reservation request received: draft ticket #CR-4321 created for Dedicated test node.

marie_sales: Great — closing with next steps in thread and I'll follow up with a short runbook doc and the quote draft.
